sections.evaluation_comments:
10/12/2026
Dog was closed to front half of kennel during AM cleaning.  Would stand up, flatten ears, lick lips & low growl while handler would unlock kennel gate.  Offered treats, would not be interested in treats, started to curl lips while being whale eyed.  Able to cast a large loop leash onto dog.  Walked slowly to small PY while walking diagonally with tail tucked under body, ears pinned back & licking lips.  Would keep looking back towards handler while making crying sounds.  Once in PY, able to adjust leash stopper.  Would explore PY while keeping distant from handler.  Dog would start to relax ears & tail while exploring with nose to ground.  Was not interested in treats.  Each time handler would approach dog, dog would sit down while flattening ears, lowering head, licking lips & avoiding eye contact.  Tolerated petting on side of body without issues.  Picked up leash & walked back to kennel while having no pull on leash, keeping tail slightly tucked under body.  Once kennel gate was opened, dog would retreat quickly inside kennel, sat down in corner near divider wall while trembling body with whale eyes, ears flattened & licking lips.  Removed leash with use of pre-attached clip leash due to dog not coming back forward with verbal coaxing.
10/12/2026
Dog did not eat previous day of dry kibble mixed with treats. Due to dog not eating for 3 consecutive days of dry, canned, or treats added, will be placing vet check. No behavior notes included.

During AM cleaning I had to move dog as wouldn't move from their bed when called. Had stiff body language and lick lipping when approaching with leash, refused offered/tossed hotdogs, had quiet low grumbles when lassoing leash, once leash was on got up and walked out of kennel with handler, once outside body language softened (tail untucked and started slow wagging) and would sniff handlers legs and follow along, walked to outside portion of kennels with no issues and ignored other dogs, used clip leash on return for easy leash removal, dog walk into kennel and I removed leash with no issues.

Flinches heavily on walk back to kennel otherwise easy return, used clip leash for leash retrieval.

NO

YES, AROUND OWNER'S 8 YR OLD LITTLE BROTHER. OWNER STATES THAT THIS DOG HAS BEEN REALLY NICE WITH THE YOUNG CHILD. SHE ALLOWED ALL PETTING AND HANDLING AND EVEN EATS OUT OF THE CHILD'S HAND.
Please describe behavior around children?

JUST 1 ADULT

YES

OWNER STATES THAT WHEN SHE SEES A CAT, SHE WILL PREY ON THEM AND TRY TO RUN AFTER THEM

OWNER STATES THAT HE DID INTRODUCE THIS DOG TO HIS MOTHER'S FRENCHIE AND SHE ATTACKED THIS DOG, BITING THE DOG AROUND THE NECK WITH 'LOCK JAW', RESULTING IN BLOOD FROM THE INJURED DOG. THE INJURED DOG WENT TO THE VET, BUT WAS DETERMINED NOT TO BE SEVERLY INJURED.

HORSES AND CHICKENS. OWNER STATES THAT SHE DOES OKAY WITH THE HORSES BECAUSE THEY ARE MUCH LARGER THAN HER, BUT OWNER STATES THAT HE THINKS SHE SEES THE CHICKENS LIKE SHE DOES CATS BECAUSE SHE WILL CHASE AFTER THE CHICKENS.

NO

NO

YES, WHEN OWNER FIRST ADOPTED HER. BUT WHEN HE TOOK HER TO HIS PARENTS HOUSE, SHE WAS MAINLY OUTSIDE.

YES, OWNER STATES THAT SHE WILL LET YOU KNOW WHEN SHE NEEDS TO GO OUTSIDE

INSIDE WHEN IT WAS JUST THE OWNER AND THE DOG, BUT ONCE THE DOG MOVED TO HIS PARENT'S HOME, THEY KEPT THE DOG ON THE OUTSIDE

NO DESTRUCTIVE BEHAVIOR

NOTHING MORE THAN WHAT HAS BEEN PROVIDED BY MCACC

MODERATE ENERGY LEVEL

OWNER STATES THAT SHE IS AFRAID OF FIREWORKS AND THUNDER. OWNER STATES THAT SHE IS OKAY WITH BATHS, BUT SHE IS THE BEST WITH CAR RIDES.

OWNER STATES THAT SHE DOES NOT LIKE TOYS, BUT SHE LOVES TO GO ON WALKS
Any escapist behavior?
YES, OWNER STATES THAT IF YOU OPEN THE DOOR AND SHE SEE'S THE OPPORTUNITY, SHE WILL BOLT OUT.
Any Door Dashes/Runs away, if so, describe?
Any Additional details/notes on behavior?
OWNER ONLY MENTIONED THAT HE WOULDN'T TRUST THIS DOG AROUND ANY OTHER CATS OR DOGS. OWNER FEELS THAT SHE WOULD BE BEST IN A ONLY DOG HOME. OWNER STATES THAT SHE SEEKS ATTENTION FROM YOU AND WHEN YOU FEEL SAD, SHE LIKES TO STICK BY YOUR SIDE. OWNER ALSO STATES THAT SHE DOESN'T BARK ALOT.
4/24/2026
How long have you had your pet?
1 YEAR AND 2 MONTHS.
Where did you get your pet?
SHELTER
Is your pet spayed/neutered?
YES.
Do you have any vaccine history for your pet?
NONE CURRENT.
Has your pet been around other animals? What kind of animals? How would you describe the interaction with other animals?
THIS PET HAS NEVER LIVED WITH ANOTHER DOG.  WHEN THIS PET IS OUT WALKING, THIS PET MAY LOOK AT ANOTHER DOG NEARBY BUT NO OTHER REACTION.  THIS PET ONCE BIT OR TRIED TO BITE A STRAY CAT THAT HOPPED INTO BACKYARD.  THE CAT RAN AWAY AND THIS PET'S OWNER WAS NOT ABLE TO VERIFY THE ACTUAL BITE OR HOW SERIOUSLY THE CAT WAS INJURED.  THIS PET NOW LIVES WITH A CAT IN SAME HOME AND INITIALLY DID OK WITH CAT WITH NO ISSUES BETWEEN THEM FOR ABOUT ONE MONTH.  THIS PET STARTED GROWLING AT THE CAT.  OWNER STATED THAT THIS PET HAS SHOWN INCREASED AGGRESSION TOWARD THE CAT.  RECENTLY, THIS PET JUMPED OVER A BABY GATE INTO THE ROOM WHERE THE CAT WAS AND TRIED TO BITE THE CAT.

THIS PET GROWLED AT STAFF UPON APPROACH IN LOBBY.  NOTICED THAT THERE WERE NOTES IN THE OS APPT ABOUT A RESOURCE GUARDING INCIDENT WITH A CHILD. GROWLS BARKS AT STRANGERS SOMETIMES.

YES.

On walk she would pull stubbornly towards whatever direction she wanted and would stop and refuse to go when prompted.  Had to use treats, pets and leash pressure to move her.

dog didnt eat
4/28/2026
dog didnt eat

Dog was laying on kuranda bed on approach to kennel.  Verbally coaxed dog forward with treats, would sniff treats but not eat them.  Would dodge leash placement while leashing.  Once leash was secured with a large loop, slowly walked out of kennel building with a lot of verbal coaxing while having tail tucked & ears slightly pinned.  Once out of building, dog would do a shake off of body while untucking tail & relaxing ears.  Walked slowly to small PY.  Would explore PY while air scenting.  Would approach handler on own, appears to know "SIT".  Dog would reposition body to have back of body against handlers legs then look around surroundings while handler would pet on head without issues.  Would look up towards handler then lean back of body against handler while being pet near shoulders.  Would walk around with handler while having a relaxed body.  Would sit near gate entrance & start to make a crying sound.  Handler would approach dog & pick up leash without issues.  Walked back to kennel with slow tail wags while air scenting.  Entered back into main building without issues & walked throughout main building with some verbal coaxing.  Entered back into kennel room & back into kennel without verbal coaxing.  Allowed leash removal to be done by hand without issues.
Interested parties should be made aware of all intake notes from previous home environment.
Placing NO SMALL ANIMALS & OLDER CHILDREN 12+ as a REQUIREMENT.  Placing Go Slow, No Children & Family Introduction as Recommendations.
Potential adopters should be counseled on slow introductions with new and unfamiliar people while dog is on leash.  Advise adopters that nervous body language is communication, not bad behavior.  Encourage them to slow down, give the dog space, avoid forcing interactions, and use calm, positive reinforcement to build confidence over time.  Interested parties should be counseled on providing this dog with proper decompression time in a new home.  Allowing time to adjust is important for their comfort and well-being.  Adopters should be counseled on proper dog-to-dog introductions, which should only occur after the dog has fully decompressed.

came into ramp on control device, advanced restraint for vaccines, wide eye, tail tucked, stiff body, resisted restraint

sections.evaluation_comments:
10/19/2026
Handler approached kennel to attempt evaluation, dog was at front with neutral body, wagging tail at spine level, began jumping up at kennel door, handler tossed treats in and reached in leash, able to drape it over head as dog jumped up and grabbed at leash, handler secured loop but dog grabbed leash again, tugging at it, handler dropped leash and allowed dog to pull it into kennel, stepped away to call for assistant handler, dog chewing on leash in kennel, whining. No other handlers available at the time, handler returned to kennel, fed treats through the door while removing leash by hand, will reattempt with two handlers as precaution.
10/19/2026
Dog was at front of kennel, jumping up, barking, door covered in saliva. Handler tossed treats, reached in leash from up high, dog leapt up and grabbed leash, pulling, handler tossed treats and dog dropped leash, handler reset, assistant began tossing treats to keep dog distracted as handler placed leash, secured leash without attempts to mouth, exited kennel, very strong pull. Handler walked dog out into yard, dropped leash, dog began to explore and sniff, neutral, still tail at spine level, ears forward and alert, dog would run near handlers and they tossed treats to the ground to avoid jumping. Dog would keep exploring yard, jumped up on fence for basket of toys, assistant threw a large stuffed tug toy, dog chased after it, dropping it near handler for treats. Handler picked it up and dog leapt up, bouncing off fence as he grabbed toy in their hand, handler briefly played tug but quickly let go and allowed dog to self entertain, dog would thrash toy, whining, running around, came back to handler and sat for treat, resumed play with toy, high arousal, thrashing toy and hitting assistant handlers legs with it, zooming around them, could not distract with treats. Quickly escalating and began jumping up at assistant handler while holding the toy in mouth, pushing at their abdomen, jumped up about 3 times with toy in mouth before dropping it, resumed jumping up at assistant, biting at their shirt, make contact with their abdomen, only left scratch marks and did not break skin, grabbed one of the leashes looped over assistants shoulder, they quickly undid it as handler grabbed leash, dog quickly flipping around and jumping up to grab leash in their hand. Assistant began attempting to lasso a second leash onto dog, dog would bit at both leashes, getting second leash caught in jaw, whining and grunting, tugging on leash, handler began tossing handfuls of treats at dog, causing him to drop leash momentarily and allowed assistant to reattempts to place second leash, got it on successfully after a few tries, dog was pulling back, whining, panting, handlers walked dog out of yard on both leashes, dog pulling strongly. Handler walking ahead had no tension in leash but dog was pulling so hard on back leash that he was choking and gasping, entered kennel easily, handler tossed handful of treats, then hand fed treats through door while removing leash by hand.
10/18/2026
Dog was neutral at front of kennel, slight tail wag, furrowed brow, licked handler through door, sat at front, then jumped up and barked once when handler withdrew attention. Requesting full evaluation due to field observation
10/14/2026
Dog confined to empty dog park when I arrived. Dog came to me immediately when I entered, gave light whining, wagging tail, wiggly body. Jumped high and tapped my face with his muzzle twice, got very mouthy with hands and leash, tried to play with leash, had to be held by collar to keep from jumping up at my face more, turned and mouthed at my shirt and pants a few times when being held. Walked on leash, moderate pulling, criss-crossed in front of me but walked with me without hesitation. I muzzle wrapped and lifted into truck with light struggle. Allowed teeth check/chip scan.
